purpose: Bounded discovery of high-impact live gameplay raster sources or animation families absent from audit/minigame_art_quality_2026-09-05/registry.json. This is not an exhaustive inventory, a pixel-quality review, or acceptance evidence.

audit_contract.finding_reason: This artifact discovers registry omissions and does not diagnose a new visual defect, assign a source score, repair a canonical finding, or change runtime facts.
audit_contract.scope: Read-only comparison of literal live raster bindings in selected minigame owners against the registry source.path set, prioritized toward actors, targets, progression states, contact objects, and child-readable cues.
audit_contract.required_next_evidence: For any source selected for audit or replacement: inspect the actual source pixels, capture the bound runtime ready/action/contact/payoff/settle states, verify atlas windows and cadence where applicable, and keep source-only, runtime, Mobile/device, child, and owner claims separate.

method.registry_observed_shape: 62 entries in assets[] / 54 distinct assets[].source.path values; this review treats the registry as known nonexhaustive.
method.correction: The initial draft mistakenly read records[].source.path, a nonexistent top-level key, and therefore produced a false zero-overlap result. This corrected draft recomputed the known set from assets[].source.path and removed the two overlaps: assets/mg/wateringcan.png and assets/mg/k_sprout.png.
steps: Parsed assets[].source.path as the known-source set.
Searched literal res://assets raster references in scripts/main.gd, scripts/games, scripts/arena, and scripts/comfy_games.gd.
Removed paths already present in the registry.
Read the selected runtime owners to distinguish active gameplay state from static room/background dressing.
Cross-checked existing source-trace notes where available so prior source-only review is reported as evidence, not repeated or converted into registry acceptance.
Computed SHA-256 over exact repository file bytes for every listed source.

coverage_limits: The list is capped below 20 prioritized entries and is not exhaustive.
Dynamic paths, generated Canvas drawing, resources referenced through scenes/resources, and string formatting were not comprehensively resolved.
Literal scans included main/game/arena/comfy owners but did not prove route reachability in a running build.
Static panoramas, ordinary room tiles, terrain/material textures, UI navigation thumbnails, and decorative-only props were intentionally deprioritized.
No Godot run, runtime capture, animation-cadence review, Mobile/device test, child session, or owner acceptance was performed.
Protected character sources are listed only to expose coverage; reuse-first action means preserve identity and source bytes.

next_actions: Extend the registry with source records for these existing live assets before choosing any replacement solely from present coverage absence.
Reuse already captured Seek, picture-garden, and Day One pool evidence where exact hashes and state timing match; record its limits rather than recapturing by default.
Capture missing live states in priority order: Seek target/actors, slide pose and fish contact, Fairy boss/cues, garden progression/payoff, then Day One contact targets.
After evidence exists, visually score actual pixels and runtime states under the audit protocol. Only sources with observed below-threshold defects should enter replacement work.
Preserve protected Roshan/friend identity sources and prefer mounting/window/cadence fixes when those are the observed defect.
